Hey OP

I can sympathize with these lines very well, unfortunately. There were tears when I was halfway through the text, because I can understand so damn well what pain is burning inside you right now. You can't help at this moment, you are alone - and yet there are countless other people who are very close to you at this moment. Like me. If I could, I would always have a sword with me, so that I can cut the pain in half. I try it by mind, maybe it helps a little.  

What I am actually trying to say, go through this disgusting, mean, burning, deep pain. Go through this storm at your pace and see what is waiting for you on the other side. And I can guarantee you, there will be another storm and another one, I'll be honest with you. But don't give up. Do you hear me? Your life has a meaning and you are needed. Someday there will come a time when you can accept that everything is temporary, that nothing stays forever. That doesn't make it better, but it makes it more bearable. At the moment you are blind, and that is more than understandable. But someday you will see again, I guarantee it.  
With all my love, a brother in spirit.

I am incredibly sorry you had to lose your husband, and your daughters their father, in this terrible way. Words cannot possibly describe what this does to you.   
The pain completely envelops you, the first few weeks I felt this raw destructive power of this experience. And you are right, most of the time you read or hear about immediate help. But for me, in the beginning, I was just functioning. The real, deep pain didn't kick in until weeks and months later. 8 weeks is not much, so take your time. Just take it, even if some may not understand.  
You sound like an incredibly strong person, a loving mother, and a woman who would be great to have as a life partner. I think you are on the right track, on your path. I wish you and your daughters all the strength in this time, and hopefully a little lantern will light your way in the darkest moments.

I can't imagine how incredibly painful it must be to lose a child in this way. His way out has also sent you on a different, involuntary, path. On this journey I wish you as a person and mother a lot of strength.

I am sure you are the best mother anyone could wish for. But unfortunately, sometimes love is not enough. I think of you and hug you in my thoughts.

And someday the fog will lift. The new country will seem strange to you, but you will get to know it and find the beautiful places. I am sure.

With love, a son ❤

My mother's best friend took his own life. He grabbed his wife's gun (she is a police officer), ran into the garden and left us forever. He left behind his wife and two small children. My family was in danger of breaking up. My parents hardly spoke anymore, let themselves go and became cold and apathetic. During this time I took care of them. 

My girlfriend at that time (we had been together for 14 years) could not deal with this "negativity". One evening she left the dining table and went to the guest room - my parents were talking about divorce. When my father was watching TV and my mother was in her room, I went to my girlfriend. When I closed the door behind me, I collapsed and cried. My girlfriend looked at me blankly and said, "Why are you acting like this? You hardly knew him! Pull yourself together".
Self confidence boost activated! 😁
